import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1].strip()
    ch = list(s)
    temp = [0] * n
    count = 0
    k = 0
    inside = (ch[0] == '(') if n > 0 else False
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        c = ch[i]
        if not inside:
            if c == '_':
                k += 1
            else:
                if c == '(':
                    inside = True
                else:
                    temp[k] += 1
        else:
            if c == ')':
                inside = False
                k += 1
            elif i > 0 and (ch[i-1] == '(' or ch[i-1] == '_') and c != '_' and c != '(':
                count += 1
        i += 1
    temp.sort(reverse=True)
    print(temp[0])
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
